rule: S-FACTORIAL T-mean arm: per-level cell means of the pre-gate temporal emission over (lane, v, gap, closing, s, k), backoff >= 30 rows (wms.model.temporal_state_table), fitted on as-is free rollouts of the init checkpoint (run init transforms applied)
notes: init checkpoint = round-9 final (round 12 init) + round 12 init transforms via the trainer init_from path; S-FACTORIAL fitted its tables per checkpoint (r10b, r11) on 48 TRAIN states x 120 s; here 6 windows x 60 s (3 batches x 2)
windows: local val-role episodes of the r9 TRAIN pool windowed as train (--all-roles-as-train); re-fit on TRAIN-split windows (more rows) on the launch host
merge_core TF term off, driver prior off, brake_follow_cav_weight 2.0 for the capture; no backward
